title: Blessed Through the Seed of Abraham
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner takes us on a journey through the life of Jacob, revealing how God's presence and promise transformed his life and set him on a path of obedience and faith. As we explore the concept of tithing and giving back to God, Pastor Chris reminds us that we are part of a larger story - one where Jesus Christ is the fulfillment of God's promise to bless all nations. Listen in as Pastor Chris shares practical and inspiring insights on how to live a life of faith and generosity.
